## Finding

### R9 - Exact focus readback drops the cancellation probe before a concrete AX copy

finding: id=R9 scope=in_scope action=fix status=open severity=medium fix_role=implementer rationale=exact-focus-readback-can-run-an-ax-copy-after-cancellation

- Failure class: post-cancellation Accessibility operation and incomplete lowest-level checkpoint coverage.
- Trigger: an exact-cursor submission reaches `validateExactFocusReadback`; `AXUIElementSetMessagingTimeout` returns for the captured application element, and the independent control plane latches cancellation before the immediately following focused-element copy.
- Expected: the exact handle's live cancellation probe and immutable deadline are checked after the timeout-setting return and before `AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue`. Once cancellation is latched, that copy and every later AX, pair, reservation, and post operation remain zero.
- Observed: the exact path calls `copyAttribute` with only the element and deadline at `FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1230-1244`. This selects the helper's default `cancellationProbe: { false }` at `FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1571-1576`. Consequently, the timeout helper checks a permanently false probe and the code continues to `AXUIElementCopyAttributeValue` at `FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1577-1597`, even if the real attempt was cancelled in that interval. The outer real probe is consulted only after the complete helper returns at lines 1241-1243.
- Reproduction: use an exact raw target that successfully completes restoration, count concrete System-runtime step observations until the messaging-timeout return immediately preceding exact focus readback, latch the attempt cancellation in that observation, and resume. The current call site still records the following `.copyAttribute` step. It eventually returns a cancellation-classified preboundary receipt and posts no Unicode, but it has already executed an AX message after cancellation authority was revoked.
- Guard analysis: other validation calls explicitly thread `cancellationProbe`, including application-bound focus discovery at `FeishuSpeech/Services/AccessibilityClient.swift:1046-1078`, exact focus/selection setters at lines 1157-1196, exact selection readback at lines 1247-1261, and editable/PID validation at lines 1264-1294. Those guards cannot protect the one call that substituted `{ false }`. The two concrete System-runtime tests cancel or expire on the first observed messaging-timeout step (`FeishuSpeechTests/FinalTextOutputSecurityTests.swift:455-538`); they do not advance through the exact restoration sequence and interleave at this later readback timeout. There is no executable all-step matrix covering every `ReviewAXStepID`, so the 321-test focused and 534-test full GREEN receipts do not falsify this reachable omission.
- Minimal repair boundary: pass the live `cancellationProbe` into the focus-readback `copyAttribute` call and remove or structurally separate default-false helper entry points from cancellation-sensitive validation. Add a concrete `SystemReviewSubmissionAXRuntime` step-indexed test that reaches this exact timeout, latches cancellation, and proves the following copy plus all later work remain zero; extend the same executable cancellation/deadline matrix across every production step ID rather than only the first timeout.
